title: Building an HttpClient reaches hosts the manifest cannot name. Use context.HttpClient.
Opening a socket directly bypasses the granted host list. Use context.Net.DialAsync.
Listening on a port the host did not open cannot be closed when the plugin stops. Use context.Net.ListenAsync.
Starting a process directly escapes the binary allowlist. Use context.Process.SpawnAsync.
Reading or writing a path directly escapes the granted folders. Use context.Storage.
A password kept in a field or a file is a password in the log and the export. Use context.Secrets.
Loading a native library yourself skips the signature check. Use context.Native.
A capability is used that plugin.json does not declare.
A user-facing string is written in English instead of a translation key.
A refusal code is written as a literal rather than taken from PluginRefusalCodes.
A media URL is built by the plugin. Use context.Media.Proxy.MintAsync.
User data is written outside the per-user scope. Use context.Storage.ForUser.
A long cycle is awaited inside a request. Use context.Scheduler.RunNowAsync.
A route path starts with an underscore, which the host keeps for itself.
A UI mount names a slot that does not exist for its kind.
IScheduledTaskPlugin is obsolete. Register jobs through context.Scheduler.
